title: What to Expect From the Next Phase of the Pandemic

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: Today.

sentences.en: As infections once again surge, what we're learning about the Omicron variant and a new treatment for COVID, and what both could mean for the next phase of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 随着感染人数再次激增，我们对奥密克戎变异株以及新冠肺炎新疗法有了哪些了解，这两者对大流行的下一阶段意味着什么。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, science reporter Carl Zimmer.
sentences.zh: 我采访了我的同事、科学记者卡尔·齐默。

sentences.en: It's Friday, December 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月17日，星期五。

sentences.en: So, Carl, the last time we devoted an episode to the pandemic, the Omicron variant had just emerged.
sentences.zh: 卡尔，我们上次把一整期节目留给大流行时，奥密克戎变异株才刚刚出现。

sentences.en: And our colleague, Apoorva Mondavili, told us that when it came to the big questions about this variant, how contagious is it?
sentences.zh: 我们的同事阿普尔瓦·曼达维利告诉我们，当谈到关于这个变异株的重大问题时，它有多大传染性？

sentences.en: How good is it at evading vaccines?
sentences.zh: 它逃避疫苗的能力有多强？

sentences.en: How sick might it make us?
sentences.zh: 它会让我们病得有多重？

sentences.en: We had to wait.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不等待。

sentences.en: We had to wait a couple weeks.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不等上几个星期。

sentences.en: And we did that.
sentences.zh: 我们确实这么做了。

sentences.en: We patiently waited, but now we demand answers.
sentences.zh: 我们耐心地等待着，但现在我们要求得到答案。

sentences.en: So what do you know?
sentences.zh: 那么你知道些什么？

sentences.en: Well, if you're vaccinated
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果你接种了疫苗

sentences.en: and you're boosted,
sentences.zh: 并且打了加强针，

sentences.en: you're probably going to be in good shape when it comes to fending off the variant.
sentences.zh: 在抵御这种变异株方面，你可能处于一个很好的状态。

sentences.en: If you're not, then the picture's more complicated.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有，情况就会更复杂。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, we know that Omicron is really contagious.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们知道奥密克戎的传染性真的很强。

sentences.en: It's about two to three times as likely to infect people as the Delta variant.
sentences.zh: 它感染人们的可能性大约是德尔塔变异株的两到三倍。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: We're seeing that in case after case.
sentences.zh: 我们在一个又一个病例中看到了这一点。

sentences.en: So, for example, in Norway, there was a Christmas party on December 8th, and there were 111 people at the party.
sentences.zh: 例如，在挪威，12月8日有一个圣诞派对，派对上有111人。

sentences.en: They'd all tested negative before going to the party, all vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 他们在去派对前都通过了检测，结果为阴性，且全部接种了疫苗。

sentences.en: 80 people came away from the party infected.
sentences.zh: 派对结束后有80人感染。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: With Omicron?
sentences.zh: 感染了奥密克戎？

sentences.en: Yes, with Omicron.
sentences.zh: 是的，感染了奥密克戎。

sentences.en: All the tests that they've done turn up Omicron.
sentences.zh: 他们做过的一切检测结果都显示是奥密克戎。

sentences.en: So this was Omicron hitting about 70% of people at a single party.
sentences.zh: 所以这是奥密克戎感染了单场派对上大约70%的人。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And then in the United Kingdom, scientists would take a look at people who are infected with Omicron and just test the people who live with them in their house.
sentences.zh: 然后在英国，科学家们观察了感染奥密克戎的人，并对与他们同住在一个屋檐下的人进行了检测。

sentences.en: Again, they would find that people were much more likely to be getting infected in that same house as they had been with Delta about two to three times.
sentences.zh: 同样，他们发现同一屋檐下的人被感染的可能性要大得多，大约是德尔塔时期的两到三倍。

sentences.en: So again and again, we can see that, yeah, this thing is really contagious.
sentences.zh: 所以一次又一次，我们可以看到，是的，这东西传染性真的很强。

sentences.en: And eventually, that started to become clear when countries start counting as many of the Omicron cases as they could.
sentences.zh: 最终，当各国尽可能多地统计奥密克戎病例时，这一点开始变得清晰起来。

sentences.en: And they realized that Omicron was doubling every two to four days.
sentences.zh: 他们意识到奥密克戎每两到四天就会翻一番。

sentences.en: So we don't know if Omicron is going to completely take over in all places, but it certainly is headed that way.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不知道奥密克戎是否会在所有地方完全占据主导地位，但它肯定正朝着这个方向发展。

sentences.en: But this isn't just going to be a replacement.
sentences.zh: 但这不仅仅是一场替代。

sentences.en: You know, in the United States, it's about 120,000 cases a day.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在美国，每天大约有12万个病例。

sentences.en: It's not like we're going to swap
sentences.zh: 我们不是要用

sentences.en: 120,000 Delta cases for 120,000 Omicron cases.
sentences.zh: 12万个德尔塔病例来换取12万个奥密克戎病例。

sentences.en: Omicron is going to keep expanding.
sentences.zh: 奥密克戎将继续扩张。

sentences.en: So you're going to have more cases.
sentences.zh: 所以你会有更多的病例。

sentences.en: Because it's more contagious.
sentences.zh: 因为它更具传染性。

sentences.en: And it keeps doubling.
sentences.zh: 而且它还在不断翻番。

sentences.en: And that doubling, we're now seeing in the United States.
sentences.zh: 这种翻番，我们现在正在美国看到。

sentences.en: The first case of Omicron was identified on December 1St.
sentences.zh: 第一个奥密克戎病例是在12月1日被识别出来的。

sentences.en: That was the first time we even had Omicron in this country.
sentences.zh: 那是我们国家第一次出现奥密克戎。

sentences.en: And now, where I live in Connecticut, for example, scientists are tracking Omicron and they're seeing it doubling less than every four days.
sentences.zh: 现在，以我居住的康涅狄格州为例，科学家们正在追踪奥密克戎，他们发现其翻倍时间不到四天。

sentences.en: And they're predicting, at least here in Connecticut, it's going to be dominant before Christmas.
sentences.zh: 他们预测，至少在康涅狄格州，它将在圣诞节前成为主流。

sentences.en: In Washington state, they're seeing similar patterns there as well.
sentences.zh: 在华盛顿州，他们也看到了类似的模式。

sentences.en: And so likely it's happening across the country.
sentences.zh: 所以这很可能在全国各地都在发生。

sentences.en: Right now, it might be just a few percent nationwide, but it's actually much higher in some regions.
sentences.zh: 目前，它在全国范围内可能只占百分之几，但在某些地区实际上要高得多。

sentences.en: So in New Jersey and New York, the White House said on Wednesday that it was already up to 13%.
sentences.zh: 所以在新泽西州和纽约州，白宫周三表示，这一比例已经上升到13%。

sentences.en: So think about that.
sentences.zh: 所以想想看。

sentences.en: 13% with a doubling every two to four days.
sentences.zh: 13%的感染率，每两到四天翻一番。

sentences.en: So that's already on track to dominance very soon.
sentences.zh: 所以它很快就会占据主导地位。

sentences.en: Right, because if it's 13,
sentences.zh: 没错，因为如果是13，

sentences.en: 10% on Thursday,
sentences.zh: 周四是10%，

sentences.en: by Saturday it could be 26%.
sentences.zh: 到周六可能就是26%。

sentences.en: By Monday it could be 52%.
sentences.zh: 到周一可能就是52%。

sentences.en: On and on and on it goes.
sentences.zh: 它就这样没完没了地持续下去。

sentences.en: Up to 100.
So Carl, the rapidity of the spread, it seems to be telling us something about this variance ability to evade vaccines, right?
sentences.zh: 卡尔，传播的迅速性似乎在向我们说明这个变异株逃避疫苗的能力，对吧？

sentences.en: So what have we learned about that in the last two weeks or so?
sentences.zh: 那么在过去的两个星期左右里，我们对此有什么了解？

sentences.en: So what scientists have been doing is they have actually been taking blood from people who have been vaccinated and they have mixed their antibodies with the Omicron variant
sentences.zh: 所以科学家们一直在做的是，他们实际上一直在提取已接种疫苗的人的血液，并将他们的抗体与奥密克戎变异株混合

sentences.en: and trying to see how well those antibodies stop the virus from infecting cells.
sentences.zh: 并试图观察这些抗体阻止病毒感染细胞的效果如何。

sentences.en: And whereas these antibodies would be pretty good at stopping other variants from infection, they're not very good at all going up against Omicron.
sentences.zh: 虽然这些抗体在阻止其他变异株感染方面相当不错，但它们在对抗奥密克戎时一点也不好。

sentences.en: How not very good at all?
sentences.zh: 怎么个一点也不好法？

sentences.en: In terms of how well these antibodies do at blocking the virus in a dish, you are seeing them reduced by 10,
sentences.zh: 就这些抗体在培养皿中阻断病毒的效果而言，你看到它们的效力降低了10倍、

sentences.en: 20, 30 times.
You're also seeing in some cases, like with Johnson & Johnson or AstraZeneca, that they don't seem to be stopping these Omicron variants at all.
sentences.zh: 你还发现在某些情况下，比如强生或阿斯利康疫苗，它们似乎根本无法阻止这些奥密克戎变异株。

sentences.en: Now, in terms of the vaccines that we're most familiar with in the United States, that would be Pfizer and Moderna, their antibodies do a mediocre job of stopping Omicron in a dish
sentences.zh: 现在，就我们在美国最熟悉的疫苗而言，也就是辉瑞和莫德纳，当提取接种了这两剂疫苗的人的抗体时，

sentences.en: when you take antibodies from people who've had two shots of those vaccines.
sentences.zh: 它们的抗体在培养皿中阻止奥密克戎的效果只是一般。

sentences.en: And there actually are studies on people who have been vaccinated to see what the actual effectiveness is of these vaccines against Omicron.
sentences.zh: 并且实际上有关于接种过疫苗的人的研究，以了解这些疫苗对奥密克戎的实际有效性。

sentences.en: So in South Africa, for example, they found that if you got the two doses of Pfizer, the effectiveness against infection with Omicron is about 33%.
sentences.zh: 因此，例如在南非，他们发现如果你接种了两剂辉瑞疫苗，对预防奥密克戎感染的有效性约为33%。

sentences.en: And that's down from like 80 or 90%.
sentences.zh: 这比80%或90%有所下降。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: The problem is that all those vaccines were designed to fight the coronavirus as we knew it in January 2020.
sentences.zh: 问题是所有这些疫苗的设计都是为了对抗我们在2020年1月所了解的冠状病毒。

sentences.en: And Omicron is a new beaSt.
sentences.zh: 而奥密克戎是一个全新的怪物。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So this is clearly why Dr. Fauci and everyone else in the federal health bureaucracy is telling us to get boosted.
sentences.zh: 所以这显然就是福奇博士和联邦卫生官僚机构中的其他人告诉我们要打加强针的原因。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The evidence is clear that boosting is a good thing.
sentences.zh: 有证据表明，接种加强针是一件好事。

sentences.en: You can actually see this again in those experiments where if you go and take the blood of someone who's been boosted and you throw it against the Omicron variant,
sentences.zh: 你实际上可以在那些实验中再次看到这一点：如果你去提取一个打过加强针的人的血液，并把它与奥密克戎变异株混合，

sentences.en: the Omicron variant does a terrible job of getting into cells.
sentences.zh: 奥密克戎变异株进入细胞的能力变得极差。

sentences.en: So the effectiveness of boosters on top of a full vaccination is still pretty strong against Omicron.
sentences.zh: 因此，在全面接种疫苗的基础上，加强针的有效性对奥密克戎来说仍然相当强。

sentences.en: So how should we think about what it means to be vaccinated right now?
sentences.zh: 那么我们应该如何看待现在接种疫苗意味着什么？

sentences.zh: 政府尚未对美国人说必须接种加强针。

sentences.en: But from what you're describing,
sentences.zh: 但从你所描述的情况来看，

sentences.zh: 真正的保护要等到你打了加强针后才会真正到来。

sentences.en: Yeah, it'll be interesting to see if there's sort of a change in language, a change in rules.
sentences.zh: 是的，看看语言和规则是否会有所改变将是一件很有趣的事情。100

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，实际上，如果你想要的是大约80%

sentences.zh: 或者90%的保护，以防范新冠病毒感染，你需要完全接种疫苗并注射加强针。

sentences.en: Thinking about the unvaccinated and the vaccinated but not boosted, what do we know about how this variant so far infects those groups of people?
sentences.zh: 考虑到未接种疫苗的人以及接种了疫苗但未打加强针的人，关于这个变异株目前如何感染这些人群，我们了解多少？

sentences.zh: 所以现在要非常精确地说明未接种疫苗或已接种疫苗等情况下人们可能面临的具体严重疾病，还为时过早。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, we have to wait for that to come in.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，我们必须等待相关数据出炉。

sentences.en: But from what we know already about COVID, what we know already about how vaccines work, it's very likely that if you're unvaccinated and never had COVID before,
sentences.zh: 但根据我们对新冠肺炎的已有了解，以及我们对疫苗工作原理的已有了解，极有可能是如果你未接种疫苗且以前从未得过新冠肺炎，

sentences.en: you're at the highest risk of getting severely ill.
sentences.zh: 你感染奥密克戎后患重病的风险最高。

sentences.en: from Omicron.
sentences.zh: 来自奥密克戎。

sentences.en: Now, if you have been vaccinated or if you've recovered from an infection, even if your antibodies don't do a great job and you get infected, you may do a better job
sentences.zh: 现在，如果你已经接种了疫苗，或者如果你从感染中康复了，即使你的抗体表现不是很好并且你被感染了，你在

sentences.en: of fighting off severe disease.
sentences.zh: 对抗严重疾病方面可能会做得更好。

sentences.en: And there is actually a little bit of data on that again from South Africa.
sentences.zh: 并且实际上有一些关于这方面的数据，同样来自南非。

sentences.en: One of their healthcare systems estimates that if you've had two doses of the Pfizer vaccine, it has an effectiveness at protecting against hospitalization of 70% against Omicron.
sentences.zh: 他们的一个医疗系统估计，如果你接种了两剂辉瑞疫苗，它在预防奥密克戎引起的住院方面的有效性为70%。

sentences.en: That's high.
sentences.zh: 这很高。

sentences.en: That's high.

sentences.zh: 它对其他变异株的有效性是93%。

sentences.en: But that's good.
sentences.zh: 但这很好。

sentences.en: I mean, that's 70%.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那是70%。

sentences.en: And that's for two doses.
sentences.zh: 而且这还是针对两剂而言的。

sentences.en: And so then the thinking is that if you then get a booster, you probably are raising your protection against hospitalization way, way up beyond that again.

sentences.zh: 对于未接种疫苗的人，我们知道吗，
